<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<CustomField xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <fullName>Run_Id__c</fullName>
    <caseSensitive>false</caseSensitive>
    <description>The GitHub Actions run id and run attempt, for example 12345678-1. The pipeline posts each run under this key, so a second post updates the same row.</description>
    <externalId>true</externalId>
    <label>Run Id</label>
    <length>64</length>
    <required>false</required>
    <trackTrending>false</trackTrending>
    <type>Text</type>
    <unique>true</unique>
</CustomField>
